subject: Modelling first time in R (lavaan Package) Need kind suggestions

messages.author: e15536ed54ae6e5f
messages.subject: Modelling first time in R (lavaan Package) Need kind suggestions
parts:
Dear All,
Hello, I am Mian Irfan, a new Ph.D. student. I would like to apply SEM to my data. I have read the tutorials and did some examples in R, now have a basic idea.
But I need your kind suggestion for model making to my data /Path diagram for my data.
Variables I have are 
1. Top.PC1.m
2. Top.PC1.cv
3. Soil.m
4. Soil.cv

My latent variables are

5. SR
6. TBA

and its effect on

7. Mort.
8. SRI

Abb: Top: Topography, m: mean, SR: Species richness, TBA: Total basal area, Mort: Mortality (Death pattern), PC: principal component SRI: Spatial Regularity Index, cv: coefficient of variation.

Need your kind suggestions and will be thankful to have some models for the above variables. 

Thanks in advance.
Mian Irfan
